{{Quote|I hesitated for a moment when I received Order 66 because the last thing I expected was a Jedi coup. Did I feel betrayed? You bet I did. I thought of all my men who died under Ki-Adi-Mundi's command, and if I'd known then that he and his buddies were gearing up to do the Separatists' work for them and overthrow the government, I'd have shot him as a traitor a lot earlier. He betrayed the trust of every one of us.|Bacara|<ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
'''Bacara''', also known as '''CC-1138''', was a [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. [[Cloning/Legends|Cloned]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Bacara received initial training from the former [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]] [[Journeyman Protector/Legends|Journeyman Protector]] [[Cort Davin]], who taught the young [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] the ideals and traditions of the Journeyman Protectors. At some point, the Clone [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] learned [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and land-based fighting. Bacara was given command of the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]], which was attached to the [[Fourth Outer Rim Army|4th Sector Army]]. Following the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] that triggered the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Bacara fought alongside several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], including [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Council member]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]. During the war, Bacara and the Galactic Marines earned a reputation as one of the most feared [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] units. Taking a break from the battlefield, Bacara joined [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17's]] [[ARC program/Legends|ARC program]] and graduated early.

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Clone Commander joined [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] Mundi on the [[Water/Legends|snow-covered]] world [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] to fight against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. As a result of the Mygeeto campaign, the relationship between the Republic and [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] grew worse, and Bacara and Mundi found themselves locked in a [[Battle of Mygeeto|three year conflict]]. Bacara did, however, leave Mygeeto for sometime and fought in a brutal [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] [[Battle of New Bornalex|battle]] on [[New Bornalex/Legends|New Bornalex]]. With Mundi and the Marines, Bacara returned to Mygeeto in the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]] of the war. On Mygeeto, the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], with the help of Bacara's Marines, executed [[Hammertong/Legends|Hammertong]], a top secret project given to the 501st by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. As the fighting intensified, Palpatine ordered Bacara to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]&mdash;a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency order]] which labeled Jedi as traitors and enemies of the Republic&mdash;via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. Complying with the order, which also called for the extermination of Jedi, Bacara and the Marines fired on Mundi and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Jedi Master.

==Biography==
===Independent clone===
{{Quote|General Ki-Adi-Mundi, the troops are ready for deployment.|Bacara|<ref name="tvp1">{{CWACite|6|To the Vanishing Point}}</ref>}}
[[File:CC-1138_Mygeeto.jpg|thumb|CC-1138 during the Clone Wars]]
[[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] 1138,<ref name="CSWE 1138">{{CSWECite|I|54|Bacara, Commander}}</ref> nicknamed Bacara, was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="db1" /> [[Gender/Legends|His]] initial training came from a former [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]] [[Journeyman Protector/Legends|Journeyman Protector]] by the name of [[Cort Davin]]. Among the many topics that Davin imparted upon Bacara were the traditions, history, and language of the Journeyman Protectors. Bacara grew to associate with the traditions which Davin taught him, and began to think of himself as a man of law and order. However, as a result of this training in the traditions and culture of the Journeyman Protectors, Bacara found it increasingly difficult to communicate in [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]], who had learned the Concord Dawn [[Concordian/Legends|dialect]] of the Journeyman Protectors, would use "''tat''" during his conversations instead of the Mandalorian "''vod''" for brother; these minor differences caused Bacara to develop into a solitary commander. Although different in comparison to his brethren, Bacara had a close friendship with [[Neyo/Legends|CC-8826]], nicknamed "Neyo." Following the introduction of the newly invented [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]], Bacara and Neyo worked together to create military tactics for the [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]].<ref name="ggar1" />

Sometime after the completion of his clone training, the Clone Commander was given the command of the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|21st Nova Corps]], also known as the Galactic Marines, a unit of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Fourth Outer Rim Army|4th Sector Army]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] triggered the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. To help defeat the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and its military forces, Bacara fought alongside several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], including [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Council member]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]. Bacara would develop a friendship with Mundi, and the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] Jedi Master even regarded the Clone Commander's behavior and aggressive tactics "as a thing of prodigy."<ref name="ggar1" /> However, at some point during the war, Bacara allowed himself to leave the battlefield and enter a [[ARC program/Legends|training regimen]] run by the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]], nicknamed "Alpha."<ref name="ggar1" /> The program was designed to bring out the independence and tactical genius which was dormant within all clones.<ref name="CSWE Alpha">{{CSWECite|I|25|Alpha (A-I 7)}}</ref> The Clone Commander graduated early from Alpha's program.<ref name="ggar1" />

By [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="swe">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="Clarify">There was some confusion among readers, since ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'' has Bacara leading his Galactic Marines on Mygeeto in 21 BBY. This was later clarified as the ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' confirmed that the Battle of Mygeeto began in 21 BBY. Due to the fact that CC-1138 and Ki-Adi-Mundi appear in several other battles following Mygeeto in 21 BBY, this article assumes that CC-1138 and Mundi return to Mygeeto sometime around the events of {{Film|III}}.</ref> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] had issues dealing with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. To counter their threat, Bacara, Mundi and the Galactic Marines were sent to the<ref name="tvp1" /> IBC [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="db2">{{DB|location|mygeeto|Mygeeto}}</ref> [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]].<ref name="CSWE Rivi">{{CSWECite|III|102|Rivi-Anu}}</ref> On the [[Water/Legends|snow-covered]] world, the group met with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Rivi-Anu]] and [[Battle of Mygeeto|fought]] against an entrenched Separatist enemy who had managed to cripple a Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]. The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] threatened to crash on the battlefield and destroy the entire area&mdash;Rivi Anu, however, [[Telekinesis/Legends|used]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to keep the damaged [[Starship/Legends|ship]] aloft just enough to allow Ki-Adi-Mundi, Bacara, and the other Republic forces to retreat to relative safety. Once her allies had made it to safety, Anu allowed the [[Star/Legends|Star]] Destroyer to fall, which [[Death/Legends|killed]] her in the ensuing explosion.<ref name="tvp1" />

[[File:Bacara-CWA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bacara on Mygeeto]]
As a result of the fighting on Mygeeto, the Republic's relationship with the InterGalactic Banking Clan worsened.<ref name="tvp1" /> The fight for Mygeeto eventually degenerated into an extended campaign of urban fighting amid the massive ruins of the Mygeeto [[City/Legends|cityscape]].<ref name="db2" /> During the push against the Separatist forces, Bacara led his Galactic Marines in the taking of the city Jygat. This battle saw Bacara order the use of glacier-busters, a type of weapon whose seismic shocks could be felt from a far distance.<ref name="True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> Along with Ki-Adi-Mundi, Bacara led the Galactic Marines through fierce [[Lightfight|firefights]] from house to house, slowly beginning to push the Separatist defenders back.<ref name="db2" />

[[Standard month/Legends|Months]] following Mygeeto, Bacara and the Galactic Marines fought in the brutal [[Battle of New Bornalex]] during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. The battle witnessed Bacara lead the Marines in fighting against the combined Separatist&ndash;Mandalorian defensive force; the Marines were also using a prototype strength-enhancing [[Armor/Legends|armor]] during the fighting. Mid-way through the battle, the weapons of the experimental armor failed, leaving Bacara and his Marines with only their [[Limb/Legends|hands]] to [[Unarmed combat/Legends|fight]]. Refusing to retreat, Bacara ordered his forces to continue the fight&mdash;using their enhanced strength, the Marines literally tore apart the B2 super battle droids which they were fighting, eventually decimating the enemy forces. Due to the fierce fighting that they demonstrated on New Bornalex, the Galactic Marines earned a ferocious reputation&mdash;one which Bacara was extremely proud of.<ref name="db1" />

===Order 66===
{{Quote|Commander Bacara, execute Order Sixty-Six.|Palpatine, to Bacara|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 3">[[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 3|''Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith'' 3]]</ref>}}
[[File:Bacara_Mygeeto_66.png|thumb|right|220px|Commander Bacara and his Galactic Marines open fire on Ki-Adi-Mundi on Mygeeto]]
When Bacara and Mundi returned to Mygeeto as of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Clarify" /> the fighting for Mygeeto's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city worsened.<ref name="db1" /> In an effort to slow the Republic advance, the Separatists used their enormous [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|tri-droids]] to lay waste to the cities. The Republic, likewise, used their [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] pieces to hammer the enemy, but managed to only aid in pounding the landscape into rubble. As a result of the incessant artillery bombardments from both sides, the [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]] of Mygeeto were a constantly [[Color/Legends|dark gray]] ash which was carried by the icy winds across the planet.<ref name="db2" /> To aid the Marines, several detachments of the 501st Legion were sent to the icy world in the execution of [[Hammertong/Legends|Project Hammertong]], a top-secret mission aimed at acquiring a power crystal for a secret super-weapon on behalf of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.<ref name="BF2">The year of the Project's execution, as seen in ''Star Wars Battlefront II'', has not been confirmed. Due to the order of the missions present in the video game, as well as the presence of the clones' [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II armor]], this article assumes that the mission took place near the events of ''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith''.</ref>

After Mundi ordered his troops to push against the Separatists, Bacara received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] via an encrypted channel directly from [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;[[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Order 66]] effectively labeled Ki-Adi-Mundi, along with the rest of the Jedi, as traitors and enemies of the Republic. Even though he had a grudging respect for Ki-Adi-Mundi and the other Jedi, Bacara's ultimate loyalty lay with Palpatine and the Republic, and he only hesitated a brief moment before complying with the order from his [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|supreme commander]].<ref name="db1" /> As the [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] led the Marines in a charge against the Separatists, Bacara and the surrounding troopers stopped, raised their [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifles]], and gunned down the bewildered Jedi in a hail of blaster [[Laser/Legends|fire]].<ref name="rots1" /> Bacara was later glad that he had killed the Jedi Master, as he considered the Jedi to have been traitors for trying to [[Showdown on Coruscant|overthrow the government]].<ref name="Order66" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:KiAdiMundi.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Ki-Adi-Mundi led Bacara and the Galactic Marines for most of the war]]
Due to his training by the ex-Journeyman Protector Cort Davin, Bacara received a different upbringing than the vast majority of his clone brothers. Learning the traditions, history, and language of the Protectors, Bacara came to see himself not only as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], but also as a lawman as prescribed by the traditions which Davin had taught him. As a result, his learning of the language of Concord Dawn alienated him from many of his fellow clones, who often chose to speak in ''Mando'a''. This caused him to become an independent individual who was often viewed as a loner by other clones.<ref name="ggar1" />

Bacara was an extremely efficient clone commander, and exceeded at his natural job as a soldier bred for war. The talents that he exhibited early on in the Clone Wars allowed for him to be selected as one of only a hundred clone troopers for specialized ARC training. Under the direction of Alpha-17, Bacara excelled at the ARC training regimen that allowed the clones to express their individuality. His ARC training enhanced his naturally aggressive tendencies, and honed Bacara into an even more finely tuned machine of war. His training and aggressiveness came to a point when he was given Order 66&mdash;even though he held a grudging respect for Ki-Adi-Mundi, his discipline and training took over, and he executed the Jedi General mercilessly after hesitating for a brief moment.<ref name="ggar1" />

Bacara's new-found individuality spread quickly throughout the upper echelon of the Galactic Marines. Being one of the most independent and outspoken of the ARC commanders, Bacara expected nothing but the best from the soldiers under his command. Wanting only the best to serve in the Galactic Marines, Bacara would not hesitate to transfer to another unit whose troopers failed to meet his high expectations. Excellent training fostered camaraderie, and camaraderie fostered attention to detail&mdash;when soldiers developed a fraternal bond with those they served with, they often chose to take extra measures to ensure their fellow soldiers survived. Bacara used Alpha-17's training program as a guide, and drilled the Galactic Marines into an elite unit, which was often called upon to act as a quick reaction force anywhere within the galaxy. Bacara's dedication to his troops, combined with his aggressive tactics, earned the clone the admiration of his leader, the Jedi Ki-Adi-Mundi.<ref name="ggar1" />
[[File:CmdrBacara-SWE.png|thumb|right|180px|Commander Bacara in full armor]]
Following his completion of Alpha-17's ARC program, Bacara instituted his own tough training program for the soldiers under his command. Under his leadership and direction, the Galactic Marines were eventually trained into a highly efficient, and elite, quick reaction force. His leadership was again demonstrated on the world of New Bornalex which saw a fierce battle erupt against the Separatist forces and the Galactic Marines under Bacara's command. During the battle the Marines found that their prototype weapons had malfunctioned, and were left with only their suit-enhanced strength to fight with. Refusing to surrender or retreat, Bacara issued the order to advance, knowing full well that that order may have resulted in the destruction of the soldiers under his command. Bacara and the Marines, however, demonstrated their bravery and dedication by fighting and destroying the enemy droids with only their hands.<ref name="db1" />

==Equipment==
Part of the Galactic Marines, Bacara participated in fierce fighting campaigns, such as the Battle of New Bornalex. During the battle, Bacara and his unit wore experimental strength-enhancing armor. Despite the prototype armor's malfunction during the battle, the defective armor allowed Bacara to engage [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] in hand-to-hand combat.<ref name="db1" /> After New Bornalex, Bacara began to sport [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]], which he utilized on Mygeeto.<ref name="tvp1" /> Because of Mygeeto's weather conditions, the Clone Commander's helmet featured blizzard protection side plates, and his armor's leggings had kneecap armor.<ref name="swe" /> During the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the Battle of Mygeeto, Bacara sported a white [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinocular]] on his helmet, a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], and wore an ammunition pouch [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]].<ref name="tvp1" /> Later, Bacara added an anti-blast [[Kama/Legends|''kama'']], and a [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]], to his Phase II armor set. His ''kama'' and pauldron sported maroon-colored decorations.<ref name="rots1" /> Bacara carried a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]]<ref name="swe" />, a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blaster carbine and sometimes a [[WESTAR-M5 blaster rifle|WESTAR-M5 Blaster Rifle]].<ref name="rots1" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|General Ki-Adi-Mundi, we have been summoned to Mygeeto. There is trouble with the Banking Clan&hellip;|Bacara's line in ''To the Vanishing Point'' was later clarified in the ''Star Wars Character Encyclopedia''|<ref name="tvp1" />}}
[[File:Bacara-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Concept art by [[Alex Jaeger]]]]
Though Bacara's numerical designation of 1138 is not mentioned in the film, it can be seen within the script for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] where he is identified as Commander 1138. The number itself is an obvious reference to [[George Lucas]]' first feature film, [[Wikipedia:THX 1138|''THX 1138'']].<ref name="swcom1">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/release/video/f20040909/index.html|text=Looking for THX 1138 in a Galaxy Far, Far Away&hellip;}}</ref> When CC-1138 first appeared in the film ''Revenge of the Sith'', some fans noticed that his helmet and armor closely resembled that of the [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] from [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. The armor that CC-1138 and the other Galactic Marines used in Episode III was, in fact, inspired by the snowtrooper designs of Episode V; building off of this inspiration, CC-1138's helmet's open-facemask design was first developed for clone tank drivers who were meant to have been operating in rough environments.<ref name="db1" /> Some concept art had identified as a "Clone Tank Driver".<ref name="The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> It's possible that the clone was originally intended to command a [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernaut]] during the Order 66 montage. In fact, during the shooting scripts, a HAVw A6 Juggernaut was to open fire under [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] command post on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="DB-Neyo, Commander">{{DB|character|commanderneyo|Neyo, Commander}}</ref>

A continuity error was established in ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''. In the novel, Bacara led his Galactic Marines on Mygeeto in 21 BBY. This was later clarified as the ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' confirmed that the Battle of Mygeeto began in 21 BBY. Due to the fact that CC-1138 and Ki-Adi-Mundi appear in several other battles following Mygeeto in 21 BBY, this article assumes that CC-1138 and Mundi return to Mygeeto sometime around the events of ''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith''.
